# The Evaluating Self

> The Evaluating Self is a reader's edition of the sources behind one question: what a person has to keep doing, and keep being able to do, when a machine can produce the work. It is built from 87 sources, from the Upanishads and the Pali suttas to papers published in 2025, by way of the psychology of judgement, the study of expertise and automation, the design of everyday things, the philosophy of mind and the papers that describe how language models are trained and scored.

Author: Abhinav Gautam. Site: https://abhinavgautam.in/

## Pages
- [Framework](https://abhinavgautam.in/framework/): the rules and theses derived from the claims
- [Claims](https://abhinavgautam.in/claims/): every claim, one sentence each, with its source
- [Pairings](https://abhinavgautam.in/pairings/): sources from different traditions that make the same claim
- [Source map](https://abhinavgautam.in/map/): how the sources support and contradict one another
- [About](https://abhinavgautam.in/about/)
